records.key: Set the display in one step. Electron microscopy windows the image between its 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles, so holes in the section and stain precipitate cannot take the whole range, and turns on CLAHE (128 px tiles) under Image enhancement, with Apply on, to even out uneven section thickness. Membranes stay dark. Inverted also turns on Invert image, so dark membranes and organelles are drawn bright and Otsu and the magnifier find them. Custom changes nothing. Every value stays editable.
records.source: Set the display in one step. Electron microscopy windows the image between its 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles, so holes in the section and stain precipitate cannot take the whole range, and turns on CLAHE (128 px tiles) under Image enhancement, with Apply on, to even out uneven section thickness. Membranes stay dark. Inverted also turns on Invert image, so dark membranes and organelles are drawn bright and Otsu and the magnifier find them. Custom changes nothing. Every value stays editable.
records.translation: Ajusta a exibição em um passo. Microscopia eletrônica define a janela entre os percentis 0,5 e 99,5 da imagem, para que buracos no corte e precipitados de coloração não ocupem toda a faixa, e ativa o CLAHE (blocos de 128 px) em Realce de imagem, com Aplicar ativado, para compensar a espessura irregular do corte. As membranas continuam escuras. Invertida também ativa Inverter imagem, para que membranas e organelas escuras sejam desenhadas claras e o Otsu e a lupa as encontrem. Personalizado não altera nada. Todos os valores continuam editáveis.
